allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of allotment of securities in Touax Texmaco Railcar Leasing Private Limited (Joint Venture Company) to the new Joint Venture Partner namely TrinityRail Global, Inc.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 7397270 securities pursuant to Preferential Issue at its meeting held on October 09, 2025
